name: ModelVariant841_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant841_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (each side launches orbs from one of three model parts at a fixed period; each spins as a textured, animated sprite with a ten-point trail towards a spread point in front of the opposing slot, then fades, bursts into a growing quartered flash and throws up to four animated sparks while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the orbs and sparks and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 once the first orbs have arrived, 1 once when the last orbs have arrived after the stop time, 2 once the light has recovered and the last flashes and sparks are done and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-858 and 955 images build it from the same source through french_model_variant/variant858_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and the US layout. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
